local function nowTime()
    return os.date("%H:%M:%S")
end

local function pushLog(action, outcome, detail)
    table.insert(S.logs, 1, {
        time = nowTime(),
        action = tostring(action),
        outcome = tostring(outcome),
        detail = tostring(detail),
    })
    if #S.logs > 60 then table.remove(S.logs) end
end

local function pushAlert(category, title, detail)
    table.insert(S.notifications, 1, {
        time = nowTime(),
        category = category,
        title = title,
        detail = detail,
    })
    if #S.notifications > 80 then table.remove(S.notifications) end
end

local function acquireLock(key)
    if S.safetyMode ~= "ACTIVE" then
        pushLog(key, "BLOCKED", "ระบบอยู่ในโหมด " .. S.safetyMode)
        return false
    end
    if S.locks[key] then
        pushLog(key, "BLOCKED", "ป้องกันการทำงานซ้ำ: " .. key)
        return false
    end
    S.locks[key] = true
    return true
end

local function releaseLock(key)
    S.locks[key] = nil
end

local function new(class, props, parent)
    local x = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do x[k] = v end
    x.Parent = parent
    return x
end

local function corner(obj, r)
    return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or CONFIG.CornerRadius)}, obj)
end

local function stroke(obj, color, thick, trans)
    return new("UIStroke", {
        Color = color or Theme.accent,
        Thickness = thick or CONFIG.BorderThickness,
        Transparency = trans or CONFIG.BorderTransparency,
    }, obj)
end

local function gradient(obj, c1, c2, rot)
    return new("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2), Rotation = rot or 30}, obj)
end

local function fs(baseSize)
    return math.max(9, math.round(baseSize * CONFIG.FontScale))
end

local function tweenProp(obj, props, dur)
    if not CONFIG.SmoothMotion then
        for k, v in pairs(props) do obj[k] = v end
        return
    end
    TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(dur or 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

-- Save / Load Settings safely via Executor filesystem (if available)
local function saveSettings()
    if not writefile then return false end
    local payload = {
        WindowWidth = CONFIG.WindowWidth,
        WindowHeight = CONFIG.WindowHeight,
        CornerRadius = CONFIG.CornerRadius,
        UiScale = CONFIG.UiScale,
        AutoFitMobile = CONFIG.AutoFitMobile,
        FilterInvalidParts = CONFIG.FilterInvalidParts,
        ShowRightPanel = CONFIG.ShowRightPanel,
        piston = S.piston,
        maxPistonPrice = S.maxPistonPrice,
    }
    local ok = pcall(function()
        writefile(CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(payload))
    end)
    pushLog("SAVE_SETTINGS", ok and "OK" or "ERROR", ok and "บันทึกการตั้งค่าแล้ว" or "Executor ไม่รองรับ writefile")
    return ok
end

local function loadSettings()
    if not readfile or not isfile or not isfile(CONFIG_FILE) then return end
    local ok, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_FILE))
    end)
    if ok and type(data) == "table" then
        if type(data.WindowWidth) == "number" then CONFIG.WindowWidth = data.WindowWidth end
        if type(data.WindowHeight) == "number" then CONFIG.WindowHeight = data.WindowHeight end
        if type(data.CornerRadius) == "number" then CONFIG.CornerRadius = data.CornerRadius end
        if type(data.UiScale) == "number" then CONFIG.UiScale = data.UiScale end
        if type(data.AutoFitMobile) == "boolean" then CONFIG.AutoFitMobile = data.AutoFitMobile end
        if type(data.FilterInvalidParts) == "boolean" then CONFIG.FilterInvalidParts = data.FilterInvalidParts end
        if type(data.ShowRightPanel) == "boolean" then CONFIG.ShowRightPanel = data.ShowRightPanel end
        if type(data.piston) == "number" then S.piston = data.piston end
        if type(data.maxPistonPrice) == "number" then S.maxPistonPrice = data.maxPistonPrice end
        pushLog("LOAD_SETTINGS", "OK", "โหลดการตั้งค่าที่บันทึกไว้สำเร็จ")
    end
end
loadSettings()

-- Clean old instance if re-executed
pcall(function()
    local old = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("BALL_KUN_HUB_PREMIUM_V5")
    if old then old:Destroy() end
    local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if pg and pg:FindFirstChild("BALL_KUN_HUB_PREMIUM_V5") then pg.BALL_KUN_HUB_PREMIUM_V5:Destroy() end
end)

local MainScale = new("UIScale", {Scale = CONFIG.UiScale}, Main)

local function updateResponsiveScale()
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local vp = cam.ViewportSize
    local isPortrait = vp.Y > vp.X
    local targetW = isPortrait and math.min(CONFIG.WindowWidth, math.max(330, vp.X - 16)) or CONFIG.WindowWidth
    local targetH = isPortrait and math.min(CONFIG.WindowHeight, math.max(460, vp.Y - 40)) or CONFIG.WindowHeight
    Main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(targetW, targetH)

    if CONFIG.AutoFitMobile then
        local fitX = (vp.X - 16) / math.max(1, targetW)
        local fitY = (vp.Y - 24) / math.max(1, targetH)
        local fit = math.min(1, fitX, fitY)
        MainScale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min(CONFIG.UiScale, fit), 0.45, 1.25)
    else
        MainScale.Scale = math.clamp(CONFIG.UiScale, 0.45, 1.25)
    end
end
updateResponsiveScale()
if Workspace.CurrentCamera then
    Workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateResponsiveScale)
end

local function restoreFpsSettings()
    if not S.savedLighting then return end
    pcall(function()
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = S.savedLighting.shadows
        Lighting.FogEnd = S.savedLighting.fog
        for obj, val in pairs(S.savedLighting.effects or {}) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                pcall(function() obj.Enabled = val end)
            end
        end
    end)
    S.fpsPreset = "Off"
    pushLog("FPS_RESTORE", "OK", "คืนค่ากราฟิกเริ่มต้นเรียบร้อย")
end

local function clearRoute()
    for _, v in ipairs(S.route) do pcall(function() v:Destroy() end) end
    table.clear(S.route)
    table.clear(S.lastWaypoints)
    S.selectedTarget = nil
    S.selectedTargetLabel = ""
    S.stagnantTimer = 0
end

local function emergencyStop()
    S.safetyMode = "EMERGENCY_STOPPED"
    for k, _ in pairs(S.flags) do S.flags[k] = false end
    table.clear(S.locks)
    clearRoute()
    pushAlert("SAFETY", "Emergency Stop ทำงาน", "หยุด Loop นำทาง, เรดาร์ และคิวทั้งหมดทันที")
    pushLog("EMERGENCY_STOP", "PAUSED", "หยุดการทำงานทั้งหมดทันที")
end

local function topButton(text, xOffset, bgColor, callback)
    local b = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 34),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, xOffset, 0, 14),
        BackgroundColor3 = bgColor or Theme.cardActive,
        Text = text,
        TextColor3 = Theme.white,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 14,
        ZIndex = 5,
    }, Top)
    corner(b, 8)
    stroke(b, Theme.accent, 1, 0.35)
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return b
end

topButton("STOP", -132, Theme.dangerRed, emergencyStop)
topButton("—", -88, Theme.cardActive, function()
    Main.Visible = false
    Reopen.Visible = true
end)
topButton("×", -44, Theme.cardActive, function()
    S.alive = false
    clearRoute()
    restoreFpsSettings()
    Gui:Destroy()
end)

Reopen.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Main.Visible = true
    Reopen.Visible = false
end)

    Main.BackgroundTransparency = CONFIG.PanelTransparency
    MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, CONFIG.CornerRadius)
    MainStroke.Color = Theme.accent
    TopStroke.Color = Theme.accent
    Art.Visible = CONFIG.BackgroundEnabled
    updateResponsiveScale()
end

local function toast(msg)
    local t = new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 42),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -336, 1, -56),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.surface,
        Text = "  " .. tostring(msg),
        TextColor3 = Theme.white,
        Font = CONFIG.FontBold,
        TextSize = fs(12),
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = 80,
    }, Gui)
    corner(t, 9)
    stroke(t, Theme.accent, 1.3, 0.15)
    task.delay(2.8, function() if t then t:Destroy() end end)
end

local function clearBody()
    for _, v in ipairs(Scroll:GetChildren()) do
        if v ~= BodyList and v:IsA("GuiObject") then v:Destroy() end
    end
end

local function section(text)
    return new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 26),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text,
        TextColor3 = Theme.white,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
        TextSize = fs(14),
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = 4,
    }, Scroll)
end

local function info(text, h)
    local f = new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, h or 48),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.card,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.10,
        Text = text,
        TextColor3 = Theme.white,
        Font = CONFIG.FontRegular,
        TextSize = fs(11),
        TextWrapped = true,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = 4,
    }, Scroll)
    new("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)}, f)
    corner(f, 9)
    stroke(f, Theme.accent, 1, 0.62)
    return f
end

local function button(text, fn)
    local b = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 42),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.cardActive,
        Text = text,
        TextColor3 = Theme.white,
        Font = CONFIG.FontBold,
        TextSize = fs(12),
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        ZIndex = 4,
    }, Scroll)
    corner(b, 9)
    local st = stroke(b, Theme.accent, 1, 0.45)
    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tweenProp(b, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.accentFill})
        tweenProp(st, {Transparency = 0.1})
    end)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tweenProp(b, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.cardActive})
        tweenProp(st, {Transparency = 0.45})
    end)
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fn)
    return b
end

local function toggle(title, desc, default, fn)
    if S.flags[title] == nil then S.flags[title] = default or false end
    local f = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 68),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.card,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.08,
        ZIndex = 4,
    }, Scroll)
    corner(f, 10)
    stroke(f, Theme.accent, 1, 0.55)
    new("TextLabel", {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -98, 0, 22),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = title,
        TextColor3 = Theme.white,
        Font = CONFIG.FontBold,
        TextSize = fs(12),
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = 5,
    }, f)
    new("TextLabel", {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 32),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -98, 0, 28),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = desc,
        TextColor3 = Theme.mutedWhite,
        Font = CONFIG.FontRegular,
        TextSize = fs(10),
        TextWrapped = true,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = 5,
    }, f)
    local sw = new("TextButton", {
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0.5, -14),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 28),
        BackgroundColor3 = S.flags[title] and Theme.accentFill or Theme.switchOff,
        Text = S.flags[title] and "เปิด" or "ปิด",
        TextColor3 = Theme.white,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
        TextSize = fs(11),
        ZIndex = 5,
    }, f)
    corner(sw, 14)
    stroke(sw, Theme.accent, 1, 0.35)
    sw.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        S.flags[title] = not S.flags[title]
        sw.Text = S.flags[title] and "เปิด" or "ปิด"
        tweenProp(sw, {BackgroundColor3 = S.flags[title] and Theme.accentFill or Theme.switchOff})
        if fn then fn(S.flags[title]) end
    end)
end

--========================================================
-- Vehicle Scanner (Owned / Accessible Check — Never Fabricates)
--========================================================
local function scanVehicles()
    local out, seen = {}, {}
    for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
            local m = v:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            if m and not seen[m] then
                seen[m] = true
                local ownerAttr = m:GetAttribute("Owner") or m:GetAttribute("OwnerName")
                local isOwned = (ownerAttr == LP.Name or ownerAttr == LP.UserId)
                local seatBusy = (v.Occupant ~= nil)
                local accessible = isOwned or (ownerAttr == nil and not seatBusy)
                table.insert(out, {
                    model = m,
                    seat = v,
                    name = m.Name,
                    isOwned = isOwned,
                    accessible = accessible,
                    status = seatBusy and "IN_USE" or (accessible and "READY" or "LOCKED"),
                })
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end)
    return out
end

--========================================================
-- Smart Thai Pin Translator & Green Route Visualizer
--========================================================
local function isIgnoredPart(part)
    if not CONFIG.FilterInvalidParts then return false end
    local fullLower = part:GetFullName():lower()
    local nameLower = part.Name:lower()
    if part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then return true end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr.Character and part:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character) then return true end
    end
    if fullLower:find("players%.") or fullLower:find("accessory") then return true end
    for _, kw in ipairs(IGNORED_PART_KEYWORDS) do
        if nameLower:find(kw, 1, true) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function translateDestination(rawName)
    local lower = rawName:lower()
    for _, rule in ipairs(PIN_RULES) do
        if lower:find(rule.keyword, 1, true) then
            if CONFIG.ShowRawNameHint then
                return rule.thai .. " (" .. rawName .. ")", rule.category
            end
            return rule.thai, rule.category
        end
    end
    return "จุดหมาย: " .. rawName, "จุดหมาย"
end

local function scanDestinations()
    local out, seen = {}, {}
    for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") and not isIgnoredPart(v) then
            local n = v.Name:lower()
            local matched = false
            for _, rule in ipairs(PIN_RULES) do
                if n:find(rule.keyword, 1, true) then matched = true; break end
            end
            if matched and not seen[v] then
                seen[v] = true
                local thaiName, cat = translateDestination(v.Name)
                table.insert(out, {part = v, thai = thaiName, category = cat})
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.thai < b.thai end)
    return out
end

local function routeTo(part, thaiLabel)
    if not acquireLock("ROUTE_DRAW") then return end
    clearRoute()
    local char = LP.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not part or not part.Parent then
        releaseLock("ROUTE_DRAW")
        pushAlert("SYSTEM_ERROR", "สร้างเส้นทางไม่สำเร็จ", "ไม่พบตัวละครหรือจุดหมาย")
        toast("ไม่พบตัวละครหรือจุดหมาย")
        return
    end
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({AgentRadius = 4, AgentHeight = 6, AgentCanJump = true, WaypointSpacing = 12})
    local ok = pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, part.Position) end)
    local pts = {}
    if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        for _, w in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do table.insert(pts, w.Position) end
    else
        pts = {root.Position, part.Position}
    end
    S.lastWaypoints = pts
    for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
        local a, b = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
        local d = b - a
        if d.Magnitude > 0.2 then
            local beam = new("Part", {
                Name = "BALLKUN_GREEN_ROUTE",
                Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanTouch = false, CanQuery = false,
                Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = Theme.routeGreen, Transparency = 0.08,
                Size = Vector3.new(0.55, 0.35, d.Magnitude),
                CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b),
            }, Workspace)
            table.insert(S.route, beam)
        end
    end
    local pin = new("Part", {
        Name = "BALLKUN_PIN",
        Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
        Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4),
        Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0),
        Anchored = true, CanCollide = false,
        Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = Theme.routeGreen,
    }, Workspace)
    table.insert(S.route, pin)
    S.selectedTarget = part
    S.selectedTargetLabel = thaiLabel or "จุดหมาย"
    S.lastPos = root.Position
    S.stagnantTimer = 0
    releaseLock("ROUTE_DRAW")
    pushLog("NAV_PIN", "OK", "สร้างเส้นทางสีเขียวไปยัง " .. S.selectedTargetLabel)
    toast("ปักหมุดเส้นทางสีเขียว: " .. S.selectedTargetLabel)
end

                    toast("รถ " .. item.name .. " ไม่พร้อมใช้งาน (" .. item.status .. ")")

                        baseline = { MaxSpeed = item.seat.MaxSpeed, Torque = item.seat.Torque },
                        best = nil,
                    }
                end
                pushLog("SELECT_CAR", "OK", "สลับไปยัง " .. item.name)
                toast("เลือกรถ " .. item.name .. " เรียบร้อย")
            end)
        end
    end)
    info("ความคืบหน้าคิวจูน: จูนแล้ว " .. S.tunedCount .. " / " .. #S.tuningQueue .. " คัน", 40)
end

local function ecuPage()
    section("ECU Tuning  •  Monitor & Profile Workbench")
    local v = S.selectedCar
    if not v or not v.Parent then
        info("ยังไม่ได้เลือกรถที่พร้อมใช้งาน กรุณาเลือกรถจากหน้าระบบรถยนต์ก่อน (ห้ามเดาค่าจูน)", 48)
        return
    end
    local seat = v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)
    local prof = S.ecuProfiles[v.Name]
    info("รถเป้าหมาย: " .. v.Name .. "\nMaxSpeed: " .. tostring(seat and seat.MaxSpeed or "N/A") .. "  |  Torque: " .. tostring(seat and seat.Torque or "N/A"), 54)
    button("📌  บันทึกค่า Baseline ก่อนจูน", function()
        if not seat then toast("ไม่พบ VehicleSeat"); return end
        S.ecuProfiles[v.Name] = S.ecuProfiles[v.Name] or {}
        S.ecuProfiles[v.Name].baseline = { MaxSpeed = seat.MaxSpeed, Torque = seat.Torque }
        pushAlert("ECU_DONE", "บันทึก Baseline ECU", v.Name .. " MaxSpeed=" .. seat.MaxSpeed)
        toast("บันทึก Baseline ของ " .. v.Name .. " แล้ว")
    end)
    button("↺  Reset กลับค่า Baseline", function()
        if prof and prof.baseline then
            toast("คืนค่าอ้างอิง Baseline: MaxSpeed=" .. prof.baseline.MaxSpeed .. " Torque=" .. prof.baseline.Torque)
        else
            toast("ยังไม่มี Baseline ที่บันทึกไว้")
        end
    end)
    info("[PREPARATION] การปรับแต่งค่า ECU ลง Server ของเกมต้องผ่าน UI/ระบบจูนที่เกมอนุญาตเท่านั้น", 46)
end

        S.pistonUserConfirmed = on
    end)
end

local function applyFpsMode(mode)
    if not S.savedLighting then
        S.savedLighting = {
            shadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
            fog = Lighting.FogEnd,
            effects = {},
        }
        for _, v in ipairs(Lighting:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("PostEffect") then S.savedLighting.effects[v] = v.Enabled end
        end
        for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") or v:IsA("Beam") then
                S.savedLighting.effects[v] = v.Enabled
            end
        end
    end

    if mode == "Off" then
        restoreFpsSettings()
        toast("คืนค่ากราฟิกเดิมแล้ว")
        return
    end

    S.fpsPreset = mode
    if mode == "Low" then
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        Lighting.FogEnd = 1000000
        for obj, _ in pairs(S.savedLighting.effects) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then pcall(function() obj.Enabled = false end) end
        end
    elseif mode == "Medium" then
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        Lighting.FogEnd = math.max(S.savedLighting.fog, 12000)
        for obj, val in pairs(S.savedLighting.effects) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    obj.Enabled = obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and val or false
                end)
            end
        end
    elseif mode == "High" then
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = S.savedLighting.shadows
        Lighting.FogEnd = math.max(S.savedLighting.fog, 6000)
        for obj, val in pairs(S.savedLighting.effects) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    obj.Enabled = (not obj:IsA("PostEffect")) and val or false
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    pushLog("FPS_MODE", "OK", "ตั้งค่า FPS Boost โหมด " .. mode)
    toast("ตั้งค่า FPS Boost โหมด " .. mode .. " แล้ว")
end

local function fpsPage()
    section("เพิ่มความลื่นไหล  •  FPS BOOST (Low / Medium / High)")
    info("โหมดปัจจุบัน: " .. S.fpsPreset .. " — ปกป้อง Script, VehicleSeat และส่วนประกอบหลักของเกม", 48)
    button("⚡  โหมด Low (ลื่นสูงสุด)", function() applyFpsMode("Low"); showPage("FPS Boost") end)
    button("⚖  โหมด Medium (สมดุล)", function() applyFpsMode("Medium"); showPage("FPS Boost") end)
    button("✨  โหมด High (คงเงาและเอฟเฟกต์สนาม)", function() applyFpsMode("High"); showPage("FPS Boost") end)
    button("↺  Restore Settings (คืนค่ากราฟิกเดิมทั้งหมด)", function() applyFpsMode("Off"); showPage("FPS Boost") end)
end

showPage = function(name)
    S.page = name
    clearBody()
    if pages[name] then pages[name]() end
    for _, v in ipairs(Sidebar:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("TextButton") then
            local active = (v.Name == name)
            tweenProp(v, {BackgroundColor3 = active and Theme.accentFill or Theme.card})
        end
    end
end

    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showPage(item[2]) end)
end

-- Drag & Resize (Touch + Mouse)
local dragging, dragStart, startPos
Top.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true; dragStart = input.Position; startPos = Main.Position
    end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local d = input.Position - dragStart
        Main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
    end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
end)

local Grip = new("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, -26),
    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.cardActive,
    Text = "◢",
    TextColor3 = Theme.white,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
    TextSize = 12,
    ZIndex = 10,
}, Main)
corner(Grip, 6)
stroke(Grip, Theme.accent, 1, 0.3)

local resizing, rs, sz
Grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        resizing = true; rs = input.Position; sz = Main.Size
    end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if resizing and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local d = input.Position - rs
        CONFIG.WindowWidth = math.clamp(sz.X.Offset + d.X, 330, 1280)
        CONFIG.WindowHeight = math.clamp(sz.Y.Offset + d.Y, 440, 860)
        applyLayoutRefresh()
    end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then resizing = false end
end)

-- Safe Background Monitor Loop (Piston 53-90 + Route Off-Route/Stagnation)
task.spawn(function()
    while S.alive and Gui.Parent do
        task.wait(1.5)
        if S.safetyMode == "ACTIVE" then
            -- 1. Piston 53-90 Shop UI Watcher
            if S.flags["เปิดเรดาร์ตรวจจับลูกสูบเป้าหมาย"] then
                local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
                if pg then
                    for _, o in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
                        if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") then
                            local txt = (o.Text or ""):lower()
                            if txt:find("ลูกสูบ") and txt:find(tostring(S.piston), 1, true) then
                                local key = o:GetFullName() .. "|" .. txt
                                if key ~= S.lastPistonKey then
                                    S.lastPistonKey = key
                                    pushAlert("PISTON_TARGET", "พบลูกสูบเบอร์ " .. S.piston, "แหล่งข้อมูล: " .. o:GetFullName())
                                    toast("พบลูกสูบเบอร์ " .. S.piston .. " ในร้านค้า")
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            -- 2. Navigation Off-Route & Stagnation Monitor (Strict separation from Vehicle Control)
            if S.flags["อัปเดตเส้นทางเมื่อออกนอกเส้น + ตรวจจับรถหยุดนิ่ง"] and S.selectedTarget and S.selectedTarget.Parent then
                local char = LP.Character
                local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if root then
                    if S.lastPos and (root.Position - S.lastPos).Magnitude < 2.5 then
                        S.stagnantTimer = S.stagnantTimer + 1.5
                        if S.stagnantTimer >= CONFIG.StagnationSec then
                            S.stagnantTimer = 0
                            pushAlert("VEHICLE_STAGNANT", "ตรวจพบรถหยุดนิ่ง/ติดขัด", "ตำแหน่งไม่ขยับเกิน " .. CONFIG.StagnationSec .. " วินาที")
                        end
                    else
                        S.stagnantTimer = 0
                    end
                    S.lastPos = root.Position

                    -- Check distance to route waypoints
                    local minD = math.huge
                    for _, wp in ipairs(S.lastWaypoints) do
                        local d = (root.Position - wp).Magnitude
                        if d < minD then minD = d end
                    end
                    if minD > CONFIG.OffRouteMeters and minD < math.huge then
                        pushAlert("ROUTE_ANOMALY", "ออกนอกเส้นทาง", "คำนวณเส้นทางสีเขียวใหม่")
                        routeTo(S.selectedTarget, S.selectedTargetLabel)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

showPage("หน้าหลัก")
pushLog("INIT", "OK", CONFIG.HubTitle .. " V5.0 โหลดสำเร็จ")
toast(CONFIG.HubTitle .. " V5.0 พร้อมใช้งาน")
